facts.text: The p95 authorization latency for CREDIT_CARD payments from 1 October to 31 October 2026 was 6,344.6 ms.
On 12 October, 341 attempts were ingested twice (11,704 raw rows vs 11,363 unique attempts); Paysight counts each attempt once and removed the duplicates in the clean view.
Attempt volume from 18 October to 31 October was +39% versus the usual level for those weekdays, over 14 days.

response.headline: Credit card payments had a p95 authorization latency of about 6,345 ms in October 2026, so the slowest 5 in 100 attempts took longer than that.
